what: Blender (bpy) hero-shot route in the container, neutral stand-in scene (primitives only, no photograph, no family media)
label: Linux container result; not evidence for Windows

machine_class.gpu: none (no CUDA, OPTIX, HIP or ONEAPI device)

blender.render: Cycles CPU, OpenImageDenoise on CPU, 1920x1080 at 100 percent, 2,938 faces

wheel.note: pip install without --require-hashes and with --no-cache-dir; the wheel is gone, so the digest was not compared

tests.name: entry check (run_sp3.sh --check)
tests.proof: READY: Avail 14390 MB is at least 3500 MB; exit 0

tests.name: guarded stage (lj_with_disk 3100)
tests.proof: ledger line status ok, exit 0, planned 3100, Avail start 14480, min 13077, end 13459, lock wait 281 s

tests.name: venv and pip install bpy==5.2.2
tests.proof: 130 s (01:20:02 to 01:22:12); pip check: No broken requirements found

tests.name: import bpy is Blender 5.2.x
tests.proof: bpy 5.2.2 LTS, hash d13f752e3b9c, background True

tests.name: four timed 1080p Cycles CPU configurations, each within 2x the table
renders are real kitchen images
tests.proof: four 1920x1080 sRGB PNGs, mean level 172 to 177 of 255, min 0 max 255; 8 samples vs 128 samples RMSE 0.087 (noise), 64 vs 128 with denoise RMSE 0.0046

tests.name: same settings give the same pixels
tests.proof: repeat of 64 samples + denoise: 0 differing pixels, RMSE 0 (PNG bytes differ in metadata only)

tests.name: memory
tests.proof: peak RSS 594 MB (no denoise) and 2,209 MB (denoise) of 16,093 MB; equals the 18 Oct figures exactly

tests.name: the script cleans up after itself
tests.proof: line 'run_sp3.sh: line 1: S: unbound variable' at the end of the run; the venv (1,008 MB) and renders (14 MB) were left; deleted by hand; fixed in run_inner; spikes/sp3_blender/test_cleanup.sh FAILS the old script and PASSES the fixed one (cleanup_regression.txt)

workbench_draft_1080p.note: EGL_BAD_MATCH printed 3 times; the render completed, mean level 116

disk_mb.note: the volume is shared; other jobs wrote and freed space during the run, so differences carry about plus or minus 100 MB of other jobs

pass_mark: one real hero frame within 2x the table: NOT judged (the real kitchen does not exist before G1, Sun 15 Nov); this run is the stand-in only
verdict: Partial: the container route works and reproduces the 18 Oct table at 0.81x to 0.86x on the stand-in; the pass mark on a real hero frame waits for G1
